Sub-Microsecond State & Verifiable Logs (0.325 Microsecond Lookup · 1.77 Microjoules · 0 Drift)
How tamper-evident logs, dual-time indexes, and zero-copy memory maps turn expensive recomputation into sub-microsecond reads.
1) Conventional software burns needless time and electricity unpacking text and recalculating answers it already solved.
2) Immutable fingerprint-chained logs and bitemporal indexes let any machine replay exact past states without guesswork.
3) Zero-copy memory-mapped lookup stores turn repeated work into sub-microsecond reads costing under two microjoules.
